title: Alexandria run record
description: The execution record for one dispatched commission, stored as research/<slug>/03-runs/<run_id>.json. Records what was asked, of whom, at what cost, and — through the instrument block — by what measuring apparatus the resulting claim landscape was produced. Legacy pre-convention runs stored as manifest.json are out of scope.

brief_sha256.description: Checksum of the brief exactly as sent. Pins the question, never the answer.

dispatched_models.description: Research models dispatched independently and blind to one another.

grading_model.description: The model that produced the claim landscape from the research outputs.

web_search.description: Whether research calls could read live sources. When true the run is not reproducible from its inputs.

instrument.description: What apparatus produced this run's claim landscape. Records facts only: whether the run conforms to the confidence-calibration spec is DERIVED from these fields at read time and is deliberately not stored, for the same reason the spec derives a score from (stance, strength) rather than storing a number a model chose. See docs/instrument.md.

spec_version.description: The confidence-calibration spec revision this run is measured against.

grader_topology.description: How grading calls were partitioned across research outputs.

oneOf.description: Spec §3.2: one grading call per research model, each seeing only that model's output. Preserves the independence the panel is dispatched with.
One grading call receiving every research output concatenated. Author-anonymised but not source-isolated: the grader has read every output before scoring any of them.

score_derivation.description: How the signed integer in scores.csv was produced.

oneOf.description: Spec §4: the grader emits (stance, strength) and the integer comes from a fixed lookup. Stored categorical labels allow rescoring without re-dispatching.
The grader was asked for the integer directly. No categorical labels stored; scores cannot be recomputed if the mapping changes.

extraction_pass.description: Whether claim identity was established separately from claim scoring.

oneOf.description: Spec §3.1/§3.2: extraction and grading are distinct passes, so a change in one cannot silently corrupt the other.
Claims, scores and report requested in one response. One call, one payload, one failure domain.

note.description: Optional free text for anything the enumerations cannot carry.
